title: Invitation to IP Manthan on “Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden" on 19th february 2026
content:
Invitation to IP Manthan on “Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden" on 19th february 2026
We are pleased to inform that an IP Manthan session is being organised by the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (O/o CGPDTM), in collaboration with the Swedish Intellectual Property Office (PRV), to deliberate on:
Patentability of Computer-Related Inventions (CRI) in India and Sweden.
This session would aim to facilitate knowledge-sharing and strengthen cooperation between the O/o CGPDTM and PRV, while providing valuable insights for IP professionals, practitioners, industry representatives, start-ups, academicians and students in the field of intellectual property.
Date: 19 February 2026
Time: 2:30 PM to 4:00 PM (IST)
Mode: Virtual (Webex Platform)
Interested participants are requested to register on or before 18 February 2026, 12:00 AM (IST) through the registration
link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeZUqSAnG1M0zSq8X0bPWL-j8cGCpznwNYTYEuhxYFKzY0k0g/viewform?usp=publish-editor
The meeting link would be shared with registered participants at their registered email addresses.
All stakeholders are encouraged to participate actively in this interactive knowledge-sharing session.
We look forward to your participation.

title: Invitation to IP Manthan on “Designs filing and examination in the EU and India” on 26 February 2026
content:
Invitation to IP Manthan on “Designs filing and examination in the EU and India” on 26 February 2026
We are pleased to inform that an IP Manthan session is being organised by the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (O/o CGPDTM), in collaboration with the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO), to deliberate on:
Comparative framework for design protection in India and the European Union
Filing procedures and formal requirements in both jurisdictions
Examination practices and substantive considerations
Exchange of best practices and institutional experiences
This session would aim to facilitate knowledge-sharing and strengthen cooperation between the Intellectual Property Office of India and EUIPO. It would provide valuable insights for IP professionals, practitioners, industry representatives, start-ups, academicians and students.

title: Invitation to YUVA IP Manthan (09 February 2026) – Stakeholder Consultation on Draft Code of Conduct
content:
Invitation to YUVA IP Manthan (09 February 2026) – Stakeholder Consultation on Draft Code of Conduct
Dear IP Attorneys / Agents,
We are pleased to inform you that
YUVA IP Manthan
is being organized in Delhi in
Hybrid Mode (Physical / Virtual)
by the O/o CGPDTM to deliberate on:
The draft notification relating to the Code of Conduct for Registered Agents and Attorneys
Public Notice on Online Public Services
TM Proposal for draft
Concept Paper on Designs Act Amendments
The meeting will also include an open discussion on the recent public notice on online services issued by the O/o CGPDTM, which serves as a cautionary advisory for all stakeholders.
Your insights and suggestions on these important matters will be highly valuable in shaping the implementation framework and ensuring the smooth and effective functioning of IP-related services.
Meeting Details:
Date:
09 February 2026
Time:
4:00 PM to 5:30 PM
Venue (Physical):
Bouddhik Sampada Bhawan,
Plot No. 32, Sector-14,
Dwarka, New Delhi – 110078

Hybrid (Physical / Virtual)

Meeting Link : https://ipoit.webex.com/ipoit/j.php?MTID=mc2128720aef77314e5c2eb8e78dfe04c
